name: toughtongue
description: Turn a brief, transcript, or tough conversation into a Tough Tongue AI voice agent that takes it — or a realistic practice Scenario that helps your team nail it. Create and repair Scenarios, run calls and demos, and learn from sessions through the hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Turn briefs and session evidence into better conversations
interface.longDescription: Turns a brief, transcript, or tough conversation into a Tough Tongue AI voice agent that takes it—or a practice Scenario that gets your team ready to nail it. The hosted MCP server handles live account actions; layered skills turn intent into scoped actions: ttai-agent owns product knowledge, scenario-maker creates, edits, or repairs, session-analyst explains session evidence, and browser-demo-builder records deterministic demos.
defaultPrompt: Get me started with Tough Tongue AI.
Create a Tough Tongue AI voice agent that calls inbound demo leads.
Create a Tough Tongue AI scenario to practice handling pricing objections.
Pull the last 50 sessions for my discovery-call scenario and list the top 5 improvement areas.
The onboarding agent ends calls too early — pull low-scoring sessions and fix the scenario.
